verdict.rationale: Basecamp documents its own cross-project aggregation. Everything Views pull all items of one type onto a single page regardless of project, a global calendar brings every project together, and a timeline-style view shows overlaps, start and end dates, assignees, and key dates. None of this evidence shows actual progress being rolled up into a portfolio dashboard: Hill Charts are described only as showing where things stand, with no cross-project rollup. missing for 10: explicit cross-project progress/status rollup (e.g. aggregated Hill Charts or completion metrics), a named portfolio view, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view

citations.quote: Everything Views pull everything of one type onto a single page, no matter which project it’s in.
A global calendar brings every project together
See overlaps, see beginnings and ends, see who’s on what, even see key dates superimposed over everything.
